sources.quote: As a result of our efficiency improvements, we are also lowering the price of these models to $2 / 1M input tokens and $10 / 1M output tokens.
sources.supports: xAI's December 12, 2024 announcement explicitly prices grok-2-vision-1212 at the $2 input and $10 output rates.

sources.quote: May 29 Cached prompt is now available You can now use cached prompt to save on repeated prompts.
sources.supports: xAI dates the availability of cached prompts to May 29, 2025, before the models.dev record, but this passage gives no Grok 2 Vision 1212 cache price.

sources.quote: Cached prompt tokens: Prompt tokens that were served from cache rather than recomputed
sources.supports: xAI describes cached prompt tokens as a distinct prompt token type; the page available today does not provide historical Grok 2 Vision 1212 pricing.

notes: The provider confirms the earlier $2/$10 input/output rates, while the June 17 models.dev commit only establishes a cache-field schema change. The available provider sources do not establish that the added cache_read/cache_write values were official prices for this model or when any provider price changed; the Wayback CDX request failed with HTTP 503, so classification and effective date remain unclear.
